title: 037 signal pairs as SimpleTrigger entry triggers: alone (vs gbb) and as a second book beside the width book (shared wallet)
label: PROVISIONAL -- one era (2023-26); the pairs were chosen with the late half in view (037 tb/tbatr confirmation), so the late half is NOT blind. Nothing is adopted.

why_these.st_pt_cmo_macd: tbatr (volatility-neutral) confirmed pair with the most even lift: 1.36 / 1.32 / 1.32 (early/late/E0)
why_these.st_pt_cmo_dcb: tbatr confirmed pair with the highest early lift: 1.71 / 1.46 / 1.16
why_these.st_pt_kst_z: tb (fixed %, what the current exits pay) confirmed pair that beat the width book in all three: 1.96 / 1.85 / 1.52
why_these.st_pt_cci_copp: tb confirmed pair that beat the width book in all three: 1.84 / 1.96 / 1.54

signals: each leg is the SimpleStrategies class's raw buy at its Parameter DEFAULTS (what 037 screened; the harvest did not load buy_params), ported into research/outcomes/audit_triggers.py with the same library calls; 0 mismatches vs the 037 harvest on ~2.0M bars per leg (10 pairs + BTC, warm-up 200 bars excluded), checked before this file was committed
setup: SimpleTriggerStrategy, PRESET ARM_D_FAMILY, family reversion (every pair has an oversold leg) -> the reversion exits of the gbb comparator; config_wf; 15 folds f00-f14
instrument: trigger causality PASS (research/outcomes/causality.py --write, all triggers re-run); no zero-trade half; arm trades >= 100 over 15 folds, else INCONCLUSIVE
alone: judge_one(arm, st_fam_gbb) (early gain > 0, late gain > 0, paired and risk not WORSENED; rule maps below)
beside_width_book: evaluation/books.py combine + shared_wallet (one wallet of stake x max_open_trades; refused and shrunk entries counted) of [w_aro, arm] vs w_aro alone: PASS = combined early AND late totals above w_aro's, AND the whole-period paired verdict (halves.split, split_after f14) not WORSENED; same-pair overlaps between the books reported (they need two sub-accounts)
decision: per arm, both verdicts reported; 'candidate trigger' if either PASSes. Four arms are tested: one PASS at p ~ 0.05 is expected by chance about once in five such studies -- report p values
seen_before: 037 tb / tbatr single and pair screens (all halves)
no backtest of any pair trigger
